title: The Keeper
summary: The Keeper accepts a monk's epic challenge for a limited time.
overview: The Keeper accepts a monk's epic challenge for a limited time.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The eligible monk must start the challenge through dialogue.
Defeat the Keeper within the thirty-minute combat window.
Maintain steady tanking and healing through his health-based taunts.
